default.headline: Database upgrade
default.intro: We are moving the primary database onto newer hardware. It is the last step of a migration that has been running for six weeks, and it needs a short window with nothing writing to it.
default.duration: Up to 20 minutes, near the start

affected.detail: Returns a maintenance page rather than an error

affected.text: The write endpoints of the API

affected.detail: Queue, and run once the window closes

default.unaffected_text: Inbound email, webhooks and anything already scheduled to send carry on as normal.

prepare.detail: Saved drafts survive the window; unsaved edits in an open tab do not

prepare.text: Set retries on write calls to back off for an hour
prepare.detail: The 503 carries Retry-After, so most clients handle this already

prepare.text: Move any export you need on Sunday morning to Saturday

default.closing: We will send one short note when the window closes and everything is back.

single-service.headline: Certificate rotation on the webhook sender
single-service.intro: We are rotating the TLS certificate that signs outbound webhooks. It is routine, it happens twice a year, and it affects one service rather than the product.

affected.detail: Pauses, then delivers the backlog in order

single-service.closing: Nothing is expected of you. We are telling you because a fifteen-minute gap in webhooks looks like a fault if you were not told.
